courses.overview: 從「國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Submarine Context and Underwater Vehicle Engineering into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: Alvin 載人科學潛器
related.why: 把「國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程」與「Alvin 載人科學潛器」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Submarine Context and Underwater Vehicle Engineering with Alvin human-occupied research submersible: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 水下載具都需以浮力、穩定、外部壓力和艙體完整性建立系統思考。
related.transferEn: Underwater vehicles share system questions of buoyancy, stability, external pressure and compartment integrity.
related.difference: Alvin 是科學潛器，國造潛艦案例只作公開工程概念；任務、尺度和支援方式不同，不能推定軍用設計。
related.differenceEn: Alvin is a scientific submersible; the domestic-submarine case covers public engineering concepts only. Missions, scale and support differ, and military designs cannot be inferred.
practice: 分開標示排水體積與重量
比較研究任務與載具支援方式

related.transfer: 長期處於水環境的設施和載具，都需要壓力邊界、腐蝕管理及滲漏偵測的概念。
related.transferEn: Water-exposed structures and vehicles both require pressure-boundary, corrosion-management and leakage-detection concepts.
related.difference: 海底隧道由地層和襯砌共同作用；水下載具靠獨立殼體與浮力控制，本比較不涉及軍用性能或製造規格。
related.differenceEn: Subsea tunnels rely on ground-lining interaction; underwater vehicles use independent hulls and buoyancy control. This comparison excludes military performance and manufacturing specifications.
practice: 分辨地層支承與獨立殼體
畫出公開概念層級的水壓方向

practiceEn: Distinguish ground support from an independent hull
Draw water-pressure directions at a conceptual level

courses.summary: 海鯤原型艦的公開歷史，適合用來辨識大型造船案的不同階段：開工、命名與下水典禮，各自只代表特定的進展。高雄台船據點是本課程的產業地理錨點，不是開放參觀或所有工序的保證。教學採公開歷史、一般造船品質與安全管理，不涉及作戰性能或潛艦製造參數。
courses.summaryEn: The public history of the Hai Kun prototype helps distinguish stages in a large shipbuilding project: construction commencement, naming and a launch ceremony each mark specific progress. CSBC’s Kaohsiung site is the course’s industrial geography anchor, not a promise of public access or a claim that every operation occurs there. Teaching covers public history, general shipbuilding quality and safety, without combat performance or submarine manufacturing parameters.

history.title: 建造案開工典禮
history.text: 2020年11月24日，總統府記錄了在高雄台船公司舉行的建造案開工典禮。公開敘述提到預算、簽約、設計與廠房準備，提醒學徒：可見的製造工作之前，已存在專案與基礎設施的準備。
history.textEn: The Presidential Office records a construction commencement ceremony at CSBC in Kaohsiung on 24 November 2020. Its public account describes prior budgeting, contracting, design and facility preparation, showing that project and infrastructure work precedes visible manufacturing.

history.title: 命名暨下水典禮
history.text: 2023年9月28日舉行原型艦命名暨下水典禮，名稱為海鯤。這裡保留官方對事件的稱呼，不把典禮日期改寫成完成全部測試、交付或服役日期；大型專案需要逐項辨識驗證狀態。
history.textEn: The prototype naming and launch ceremony was held on 28 September 2023, with the name Hai Kun. The event is kept distinct from completion of all testing, delivery or commissioning. Large projects require verification status to be identified milestone by milestone.

courses.connection: 相鄰課題可選港灣、船塢與民用船舶：比較塢體、排水設備、起重設施和人員通道如何共同服務建造流程。可用一般貨船的分段示意圖學習工序依賴、檢驗停留點與防蝕紀錄，再與橋梁鋼構的製造追溯比較。
courses.connectionEn: Adjacent topics include harbors, dry docks and civilian vessels. Compare how dock structures, drainage, lifting facilities and personnel access support a construction workflow. A generic cargo-ship block diagram can teach dependencies, inspection hold points and corrosion-protection records, then be compared with traceability for fabricated bridge steelwork.
